Scientific Instruments Change - Banquereau, Sable
Wave glider C34164NS is transiting from 44 17.687N 057 51.097W along the following coordinates in sequence:
44 19.158N 058 10.699W, 
44 19.394N 059 20.984W, 
Wave glider c34164ns is copper in colour with a mast extending 1.2 metres above the surface of the water, supporting a solid white light and orange visibility flag and is equipped with a non-transmitting ais receiver. It is remotely operated, moving at a speed of approximately 1.2 knots and measuring 3.05 metres by 0.81 metres.
For further information, authorities and mariners may contact sue l’orsa at 250-877-8052, tyler byrne at 902-719-7078, or liquid robotics wave glider operations centre at +1 888-574-4574 or 408-636-4205.
